items.title: Corepresentability of the flat at a point functor in the henselian essentially finite type case
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The theorem is the local flatterling statement: for a henselian local A, a B essentially of finite type over A and a finite B-module M, the functor of local homomorphisms along which the localisations of M are flat is corepresented by A/I for an ideal I, which is finitely generated when A -> B and M are of finite presentation (statement lines 6789-6807, tag 05PG). The counted proof is a genuine induction on the length of a complete devissage: it must transport corepresentability across the finite steps of the devissage, replace A by the quotient corepresenting the subfunctor coming from the cokernel, use that a flat such cokernel is free over A, and then recognise the remaining condition as the isomorphism condition for a presentation map via universal exactness before invoking the flatterling map theorem. The reduction chain is the substance, so the claim is H2.
